articles.headline: Five-star Senegal make the most of last-gasp chance to reach FIFA World Cup knockouts
articles.description: While the jury's still out on this expanded 48-team FIFA World Cup, Senegal won't be complaining after thumping Iraq 5-0 to keep their hopes of reaching the knockout stages alive in their final Group I game.

articles.headline: Dembélé hat trick vs. Norway confirms France are a World Cup favorite
articles.description: It didn't matter that Norway rested all their stars, because the galaxy of French talent -- led by the remarkable Ousmane Dembélé -- shone as brightly as ever in a 4-1 win.

articles.headline: Senegal keep knockouts dream alive with thumping win over Iraq
articles.description: Pape Gueye's brace capped off a perfect game for Senegal with a 5-0 win over Iraq to leave Graham Arnold's team winless at the 2026 FIFA World Cup.

articles.headline: World Cup Daily LIVE: Yamal gets WWE belt; Spain to face Uruguay
articles.description: We continue with the final days of the 2026 FIFA World Cup group stage as we figure out who will qualify for the knockout stage.

articles.headline: Senegal thrash Iraq 5-0, on course for World Cup knockouts
articles.description: Senegal racked up the goals on 10-man Iraq in a 5-0 victory Friday that boosted their hopes of reaching the World Cup knockout stages.

articles.headline: 2026 World Cup: How teams can advance to the knockout rounds
articles.description: Who can secure qualification before the group stage ends, and whose World Cup dreams could be shattered? Here's what you need to know.
